 CAT 2026 ADMIT CARD NEW RELEASE DATE 
 CAT 2026 Admit Card New Release Date: Check Hall Ticket Schedule
 CAT 2026 admit card release date revised to November 6. Check the updated hall ticket schedule, download steps, exam date and mock test details. Lavkesh Singh 5 Nov, 2026 Share

  Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Indore has revised the release date of the CAT 2026 admit card. Candidates who were earlier expecting their hall tickets on November 4, 2026, will now be able to download them from November 6, 2026.
 Registered candidates can access their Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026 admit cards through the official website, iimcat.ac.in, using their registered User ID and password. The admit card download facility will remain available until November 29, 2026, the examination date.
 Along with the hall tickets, IIM Indore will also make the official CAT 2026 mock test available on November 6. Candidates can use the mock test to become familiar with the computer-based examination interface before appearing for the actual test.
 CAT 2026 Admit Card New Release Date
 IIM Indore has postponed the CAT 2026 admit card release from November 4 to November 6. The revised schedule gives registered candidates access to their hall tickets through the official CAT portal.
 Candidates should note that the change is limited to the admit card release date. The CAT 2026 examination will continue to take place on November 29, 2026.
 For details about the earlier hall ticket announcement, candidates can also read the CAT 2026 Admit Card Previous Update .
 CAT 2026 Admit Card: Important Dates
 Candidates should keep track of the revised admit card schedule and other important examination dates.

 Candidates looking for information about the examination notification, registration schedule and eligibility requirements can refer to the CAT 2026 Notification .
 How to Download CAT 2026 Admit Card?
 Once the download link is activated, registered candidates can access their CAT 2026 hall tickets by following these steps:
 Visit the official CAT website at iimcat.ac.in.
 Click on the Registered Candidate Login option.
 Enter your registered User ID and password.
 Submit the login details to access the candidate dashboard.
 Locate the CAT 2026 Admit Card download link.
 Click on the link to view your hall ticket.
 Check the details printed on the admit card carefully.
 Download the PDF and take a clear printout for examination day.
 Candidates should keep their login credentials ready to avoid delays while accessing the document.
 Details Mentioned on CAT 2026 Admit Card
 The CAT 2026 admit card contains important information about the candidate and the examination. After downloading it, candidates should verify all the details mentioned on the hall ticket.
 Details 
 What to Check 
 Candidate's name 
 Correct spelling and personal details 
 Registration number 
 CAT application or registration ID 
 Photograph and signature 
 Clarity and correctness 
 Date of birth 
 Correct date of birth 
 Examination date 
 November 29, 2026 
 Examination slot 
 Allotted session 
 Reporting time 
 Required reporting time 
 Examination centre 
 Centre name and complete address 
 Candidates should immediately report any discrepancy in their personal or examination details to the concerned authorities. For a detailed verification list, read the CAT 2026 Admit Card Checklist: 10 Things to Verify Before Exam Day .
 CAT 2026 Admit Card: Documents to Carry on Exam Day
 Candidates must carry a printed copy of their CAT 2026 admit card to the examination centre. They should also bring a valid original photo identity proof as prescribed in the examination instructions.
 Before leaving for the examination centre, candidates should check the reporting time, allotted slot and centre address mentioned on their hall tickets.
 For more information about permitted documents and restricted items, candidates can check the CAT 2026 Exam Day Guidelines .
 If candidates face any difficulty while downloading their hall tickets or accessing the official portal, they can refer to the CAT 2026 Helpdesk and Official Information Sources .
 CAT 2026 Mock Test to Be Available on November 6
 Along with the revised admit card schedule, IIM Indore will also release the official CAT 2026 mock test on November 6.
 The mock test will help candidates understand the computer-based examination interface, question navigation and answer submission process. Aspirants can use this facility to become comfortable with the test environment before the examination.
 Candidates can also explore the CAT Mock Test Series for additional practice and preparation.
 CAT 2026 Exam Date and Slot Timings
 IIM Indore will conduct the Common Admission Test (CAT) 2026 on November 29, 2026, in computer-based test mode. The examination will be held in three sessions.
 The announced examination timings are as follows:
 Exam Slot 
 Timing 
 Slot 1 
 8:30 AM to 10:30 AM 
 Slot 2 
 12:30 PM to 2:30 PM 
 Slot 3 
 4:30 PM to 6:30 PM 
 Candidates must check their individual admit cards to confirm their allotted slot and reporting time. For further details, read the CAT 2026 Exam Date and Three-Session Schedule .
 CAT 2026 Preparation: Important Topics to Revise
 With the examination scheduled for November 29, candidates should focus on revising important topics and practising questions from all three sections.
 The CAT 2026 examination covers the following sections:
 Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension (VARC): Reading comprehension, para jumbles and verbal ability.
 Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning (DILR): Charts, tables, graphs, arrangements and logical puzzles.
 Quantitative Aptitude (QA): Arithmetic, algebra, geometry and other mathematical topics.
 Candidates should revise important concepts, practise mock tests and analyse their performance to identify areas that need improvement.
 For section-wise topics and the marking scheme, refer to the CAT Syllabus 2026 . Candidates can also review the CAT 2026 Exam Pattern to understand the examination structure and sectional time limits.
 CAT 2026 Admit Card FAQs
 When will the CAT 2026 admit card be released?
 The CAT 2026 admit card is scheduled to be released on November 6, 2026, instead of the earlier date of November 4. Where can candidates download the CAT 2026 admit card?
 Candidates can download their hall tickets from the official website, iimcat.ac.in. What login details are required to download the CAT admit card?
 Candidates need their registered CAT 2026 User ID and password to access the admit card. Have questions about your prep?
